## New

- Connect multiple GitHub and GitLab accounts to bring pull requests and reviews into your journal.
- Explore repository summaries and linked activity from the Hub.
- Write multilingual entries with automatic text direction and collapsible toggle blocks.

## Updates

- Browse large activity weeks more smoothly while repository imports and history loading show their progress.
- Find preferences, connections, templates, and backups in refreshed settings panels.

## Fixes

- Recover writing and connection failures more reliably, with clearer errors and safer retries.

## Supported machines and installation

Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit Intel or AMD (x64).

Download and run `gitorian-0.1.8-windows-x64-setup.exe` from **Assets** below to install Gitorian. Existing installations can download this update in the background and restart when ready.

See the [installation details](https://github.com/XII-A/gitorian#downloads) for unsigned installer warnings and checksums.
